description: Loads an embedded x64 shellcode payload into dynamically allocated memory in the current process, changes the memory protection to executable, and runs the payload using a newly created local thread.

loader.role: allocates local memory, copies embedded shellcode into the allocated region, changes memory protection, and creates a thread at the shellcode address

payload.role: custom x64 shellcode executed from local process memory
payload.payload_generation: nasm -f win64 calc.asm -o calc.obj; objcopy -O binary calc.obj calc.bin; xxd -i calc.bin

loader: VirtualAlloc
memcpy
VirtualProtect
CreateThread
WaitForSingleObject
CloseHandle
VirtualFree
GetLastError

payload_behavior.description: The embedded shellcode resolves kernel32.dll and WinExec at runtime, builds the calc.exe command string on the stack, and invokes WinExec to launch Calculator.
expected_actions: walk loaded module structures to locate kernel32.dll
build the calc.exe argument on the stack

code_placement: Raw shellcode bytes embedded as an unsigned char array and copied into private memory allocated inside the current process
execution_trigger: Immediate execution via CreateThread with the allocated memory region as the thread start address

loader: embedded unsigned char shellcode buffer
calc.exe string embedded in shellcode bytes
WinExec string embedded in shellcode bytes
VirtualAlloc allocating local PAGE_READWRITE memory
memcpy copying shellcode into allocated memory
VirtualProtect changing memory protection to PAGE_EXECUTE_READ
CreateThread using allocated memory as LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE
WaitForSingleObject waiting on shellcode thread
VirtualFree releasing allocated memory
absence of CreateFileA or WriteFile payload drop behavior
absence of WinHTTP or network retrieval logic
absence of remote process injection APIs such as OpenProcess, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, or CreateRemoteThread
payload: GS segment access pattern used to locate the PEB
PE header and export directory parsing
direct call to resolved WinExec address

loader: allocates private PAGE_READWRITE memory in the current process
copies embedded shellcode into allocated memory
changes allocated memory protection to PAGE_EXECUTE_READ
creates a local thread with start address inside private allocated memory
waits for the shellcode thread to complete
frees allocated memory after execution
payload: shellcode executes from private memory inside the loader process
kernel32.dll export table is resolved at runtime
calc.exe is launched by the shellcode
shellcode thread returns after WinExec invocation
process: no second-stage executable is written to disk
no remote process is opened or injected

semantic_meaning: Demonstrates a fileless local shellcode loader pattern in which a payload is embedded as raw bytes, staged into executable memory within the current process, and executed directly without writing a separate payload executable to disk.

control_notes.payload_effect: launches calc.exe as a benign execution marker

success_conditions: VirtualAlloc successfully allocates local memory for the shellcode
embedded shellcode bytes are copied into the allocated memory region
VirtualProtect successfully changes memory protection to PAGE_EXECUTE_READ
CreateThread successfully starts execution at the allocated shellcode buffer
loader waits for the shellcode thread and exits cleanly
